description: Fibocom FM350-GL (MediaTek T700), RNDIS + AT composition 0e8d:7127 (AT+GTUSBMODE? 41; 7126 is mode 40, also RNDIS). Not NCM: the Modem Zoo, another modem manager 3.5.8 and QModem all read 40/41 as RNDIS. ModemManager has no dial path for it (HANDOFF 174). The engine's own AT dial first, QModem by the operator's choice (the owner's bench 2026-10-21: stable under the engine, a storm under QModem, whose dial guesses the gateway as x.y.z.1 that the modem does not answer). AT on interface 6 (bench 2026-10-19; 7 ttys, the number of the tty depends on the other modems)

hints.at_source: bench 2026-10-19 (OPi Zero 3, 25.12, firmware 81600.0000.00.29.24.02, GTUSBMODE 41): RNDIS 00/01, option on 02/03/04/06/07/08/09, ADB 05 unbound; the probe answered AT on ttyUSB7 = 4-1.3:1.6 only (02 not AT, the others silent)
hints.ussd_source: another modem manager quirks.sh (AT+CUSD=1 answers neither OK, ERROR nor +CUSD on any port, every DCS and charset); field reports (Modem Zoo TELEGRAM-FIELD-NOTES); our bench 2026-10-26 (OPi Zero 3, 81600.0000.00.29.24.02): *110*10# no answer in 40 s

recovery.source: IP without traffic is cured by a new session; CFUN=1,1 left AT alive and the radio dead (F28); a warm reboot needed a replug (4PDA 1057776-4745); another modem manager 3.5.8 restarts the session, then the USB port

radio.source: QModem 3.3.0 vendor/fibocom.sh (GTACT, MediaTek NR); another modem manager fm350 profile
